findings.evidence: template/scripts/start_task.py: `defer_rollout = rollout_deferred(os.environ)` is the first line of start_task, ahead of `preflight(root)` and the `harness_mode(config) != "platform"` check. The spec scenario "Deferral does not affect project-owned harnesses" says platform reconciliation is skipped exactly as before. The invalid-value scenario only requires failing before rollout observation. The edge case (project harness plus invalid value) is untested and unspecified.
findings.summary: start_task validates the deferral variable before the harness_mode gate. A harness_mode=project repository therefore fails on an invalid DEV_PLATFORM_DEFER_ROLLOUT value, although the spec says project-owned harnesses are unaffected "with or without the deferral".

findings.evidence: template/scripts/agent_doctor.py main(): `pending_rollout_report(rollout_outcome, branch, rollout_preflight.rollout_deferred(os.environ))` has no try/except, and it runs after the observation. The observation therefore happens before the value is validated, on that standalone path.
findings.summary: agent_doctor.main calls rollout_deferred(os.environ) without handling RolloutDeferralError. Run standalone with an invalid value, it exits with a traceback instead of a clear named error. The spec only covers failure at task start.
